content.text: No non-compete or field-of-use restriction exists anywhere in the agreement; the only relevant language expressly preserves our freedom to operate.

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete, exclusivity or field-of-use restriction binding us. Searches for competing-business, exclusivity, restriction, solicitation, "shall not develop/market/sell/engage" and similar-services language returned only (i) confidentiality and license-scope provisions (p0002, p0059, p0060), which are ordinary and not restrictive covenants, and (ii) § 1 (p0001), which affirmatively disclaims any exclusive arrangement and confirms the Agreement will not restrict our offering or selling Inventory through other agents or third parties. This meets the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer), and the express non-exclusivity language operates in our favour, so no redline is warranted.
